name: Super Singh
summary: Diljit Dosanjh's turbaned hero in the 2017 Punjabi superhero comedy Super Singh. He is a Canada-based Punjabi who discovers that his powers come from his turban.
origin: Sajjan Singh is a Punjabi man living in Canada with his mother, who goes by Sam to fit in. His mother accidentally swaps his turban with one belonging to a man escaping death, and during a rugby game Sajjan finds he has superpowers. He later learns the turban is the cause. Anurag Singh wrote and directed the film, billed as the first Punjabi-language superhero movie. Circumstances bring Sajjan back to his hometown in Punjab, where he sets off on a path of self-discovery; his childhood friend Twinkle (Sonam Bajwa) secretly loves him.
powers: Superhuman abilities tied to his turban

storyline.title: Sam from Canada
storyline.beat: Sajjan Singh lives in Canada with his mother and calls himself Sam. A turban mix-up and a rugby game he plays to impress a girl named Cathy reveal his strength.

storyline.title: Powers in the turban
storyline.beat: He works out that the turban is the cause just as he is about to cut his hair for Cathy. He drops that plan, since she looks down on his culture, and embraces his identity.

storyline.title: Facing a fake guru
storyline.beat: As Super Singh he stands up to the fraudulent guru Dass and protects the Darbar Sahib from an attack.

storyline.title: A fake Spider-Man
storyline.beat: The film ends with a cameo by a fake-looking Spider-Man, played by singer Sharry Mann.

gossip.text: Diljit says the idea came after fans edited his face onto Superman's body online after Jatt & Juliet.
It took nearly two years to find a producer because of the high budget.
Sharry Mann cameos as a fake Spider-Man at the end.
It was Ekta Kapoor's first Punjabi production.

timeline.title: A Punjabi superhero is announced
timeline.note: Diljit and Balaji reveal the film with a pun on his surname and tease a June 2017 release; Balaji unveils its first look on 17 January 2017.

timeline.title: Motion poster and trailer
timeline.note: A motion poster in a Phulkari-style cape and blue mask comes first; the trailer was set for 9 May 2017.

timeline.title: Soundtrack
timeline.note: The five-track album by Jatinder Shah drops on 5 June via Zee Music Company.

timeline.title: Worldwide release
timeline.note: Super Singh opens on 16 June on about 1,100 screens, the widest Punjabi release then.

timeline.title: Release week and reviews
timeline.note: The film opens alongside Cars 3 in India and Bank Chor, and critics give it mixed 2 to 3 star ratings.

facts.text: Diljit Dosanjh says the idea came after Jatt & Juliet (2012), when he saw an online image of his face on Superman's body.
The hero's powers do not come from an accident or a meteor: his mother mixed up his turban with one belonging to a man escaping death, and that turban holds the power.
Sajjan, who calls himself Sam in Canada, first discovers his strength during a rugby game he joins to impress a girl named Cathy, when he fears her boyfriend will beat him up.
He realises the turban is the cause as he is about to cut his hair for Cathy; he then stops, because she thinks his culture inferior, and embraces being a Singh.
Singer Sharry Mann has a guest role as a fake-looking Spider-Man, who chats with the hero and turns out to be an actor.
The team designed the costume, the mask and the turban together in Mumbai instead of hiring Western experts, and the turban is central to the look.
A motion poster shared before the trailer showed Diljit in a Phulkari-style cape and a blue mask as Punjab's first superhero.
Director Anurag Singh told Gulf News the film is not a spoof or satire like Deadpool; it is meant to be fun, with a message but no sermon.
The poster tagline, Ikk Te Assi Singh, Utton Super, plays on the surname Singh and the word super, echoing Diljit's own pun when he announced the film.
The story is set in Canada and was filmed in Montreal as well as in India.
Super Singh is listed as the fifth film Diljit made with director Anurag Singh, after Jatt & Juliet, Jatt & Juliet 2, Punjab 1984 and Disco Singh, though Gulf News counts it as the fourth.
Sonam Bajwa plays Twinkle, a childhood friend in Punjab who secretly loves Sajjan while he chases Cathy in Canada.
The film opened the same week as Cars 3 in India and the Hindi film Bank Chor.
Reviews were mixed: News18 gave 2.5 out of 5, Gulf News and Hindustan Times 2, and The Indian Express 3, which praised its jokes and Diljit's easy charm over its script and effects.
A reviewer at The Quint said the finale, with a villain firing missiles, recalled the theatrics of Mogambo in Mr. India.
Anurag Singh would not reveal the budget but said it was a fraction of Hollywood superhero films and of A Flying Jatt, and that his own director's fee went back into the film.
A Flying Jatt, another turbaned superhero film from the same Balaji camp, starred Tiger Shroff; Singh says the likeness stops at the turban and costume, and he had not even seen it.
Balaji Motion Pictures unveiled the film's first look on 17 January 2017, months before the June release.
The five-track soundtrack by Jatinder Shah includes Hawa Vich, sung by Diljit with Sunidhi Chauhan, and a closing song, Super Singh Ji Aaye Aa, sung by traditional singers.

Singh notes that Bollywood often casts Sikh characters just for comic relief and that Punjabis' fun-loving image has led to stereotyping; he hoped this film and Diljit's earlier Udta Punjab role would help change that.
Gulf News's feature lists Super Singh alongside earlier Indian screen heroes such as Krrish, Robot, Mr. India, Ra.One, Ajooba and Shaktiman.

kidSummary: Super Singh is a Punjabi film hero. Sajjan, a young man living in Canada, finds that his powers come from his turban, and he decides to be proud of who he is.

story.title: Sam in Canada
story.text: Sajjan lives in Canada with his mother and calls himself Sam so he will fit in with his friends.

story.title: A turban mix-up
story.text: His mother swaps his turban with another man's. Soon after, Sajjan finds he is suddenly very strong.

story.title: Finding the secret
story.text: He works out that the turban gives him his powers just as he is about to cut his hair, and he chooses to keep it.

story.title: Proud of who he is
story.text: He stops trying to hide his culture and becomes Super Singh, a hero who can fly.

story.title: Saving the day
story.text: He stops a fake guru named Dass from hurting a holy place, and then has a funny chat with a pretend Spider-Man.
